ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Child Care Funding Cuts on Low-Income Families
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of federal child care funding cuts on low-income families in Colorado and Minnesota
questions: What are the consequences of reduced funding?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the human impact of funding cuts and potential for increased fraud and abuse
